title: Key West Center Console Boat Rental With Sound and Seat Upgrade
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Dive tanks are not allowed on rental boats per Florida state law

Florida Boaters Safety: Florida Law requires everyone born after Jan 1, 1988 to take a boaters safety test to drive a boat. Each driver must present a passed boaters safety test prior to departure. You can do these online or on-site!
A Credit Card Authorization for $1000 is required for deposit & will be taken on-site
Guests are responsible for gas. The boat will be filled back up at the marina.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: We are Key West's largest boat rental service and have been helping travelers explore our local waterways for over 39 years. Our boats are located at a full service marina with ice, gas, snacks, drinks, beer, fishing equipment, bait and so much more. We are your one stop shop for everything you need to enjoy your time on the water. Our expert staff will guide you through the boat and give directions to local hotspots. Book with Sunset Watersports and see the difference.
